name: Clio MCP (Clio Work connector)
description: Connects Claude and Codex to Clio Work so lawyers can do legal research, review documents, draft memos and motions, and pull Clio Manage matter records.

skills.name: Legal Research
skills.description: Researches a legal question with the firm's legal sources and returns the answer with links to the underlying authority.

skills.name: Draft Legal Documents
skills.description: Drafts first versions of memos, letters, clauses, motions, and other legal documents using the matter's context in Clio Work.

skills.name: Matter Context
skills.description: Pulls matter documents, correspondence, deadlines, and history, plus Clio Manage and Clio Grow records when the firm subscribes.

skills.name: Legal Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes the strengths, weaknesses, risks, and counterarguments of a legal position and returns the sources behind it.

skills.name: Court Filings
skills.description: Retrieves court filings and procedural history for US matters so the analysis reflects what has happened in court.
